items.text: Growth Intelligence: Own the "Source of Truth" dashboard. You will extract and analyze operational data to identify growth drivers and provide the analytical foundation for our strategic roadmap.
Strategic Modeling: Assist in maintaining robust performance models. You will learn to translate complex business operations into audit-ready financial and operational KPIs.
Executive Presentation: Build high-impact presentation decks for business updates, translating complex data into intuitive visual narratives for the Board and senior management.
Data Governance & Diligence: Manage the corporate Data Room, ensuring that all reference materials are meticulously organized for strategic reviews and due diligence processes.

Stakeholder Support (10%): Provide data-backed responses for sophisticated inquiries and support the fundraising pipeline by managing the flow of due diligence materials and tracking investor follow-ups.
Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field, with a preference for Business Analytics, Management Information Systems (MIS), or Data Science.
2–4 years in an analytically rigorous role, such as a Business Analyst, Data Analyst, or Strategic Finance Associate.
Advanced data manipulation skills with a proven ability to build robust models and analyze large datasets with 100% accuracy.
Proficiency in data analysis tools and techniques, including BI tools (Tableau, Power BI), SQL, and expert-level Excel.
A strong understanding of how core business metrics (CAGR, Unit Economics, Margins) drive company valuation and strategic direction.
Professional fluency in English and Mandarin (written and verbal).

description.text:
<Role Overview>
We are seeking an ambitious Growth Analytics Associate to serve as the analytical engine behind our corporate strategy. This is a high-visibility "bridge" role designed for a data-driven professional who wants to transition from raw data processing to strategic business intelligence.
In this role, you won't just be crunching numbers; you will be mentored by senior leadership to understand the "why" behind the data. Your mission is to transform operational metrics into the high-level narratives that drive company valuation. This is an ideal position for a Business Analyst looking to gain "front-row" experience in corporate growth, fundraising, and executive-level decision-making.
<Responsibilities>
● Growth Intelligence: Own the "Source of Truth" dashboard. You will extract and analyze operational data to identify growth drivers and provide the analytical foundation for our strategic roadmap.
● Strategic Modeling: Assist in maintaining robust performance models. You will learn to translate complex business operations into audit-ready financial and operational KPIs.
● Executive Presentation: Build high-impact presentation decks for business updates, translating complex data into intuitive visual narratives for the Board and senior management.
● Data Governance & Diligence: Manage the corporate Data Room, ensuring that all reference materials are meticulously organized for strategic reviews and due diligence processes.
● Stakeholder Support (10%): Provide data-backed responses for sophisticated inquiries and support the fundraising pipeline by managing the flow of due diligence materials and tracking investor follow-ups.
<Requirements>
● Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field, with a preference for Business Analytics, Management Information Systems (MIS), or Data Science.
● 2–4 years in an analytically rigorous role, such as a Business Analyst, Data Analyst, or Strategic Finance Associate.
● Advanced data manipulation skills with a proven ability to build robust models and analyze large datasets with 100% accuracy.
● Proficiency in data analysis tools and techniques, including BI tools (Tableau, Power BI), SQL, and expert-level Excel.
● A strong understanding of how core business metrics (CAGR, Unit Economics, Margins) drive company valuation and strategic direction.
● Professional fluency in English and Mandarin (written and verbal).
